adaptations: React layout-effect commits become an owned synchronous ExtensionRuntimeCommit published before native lifecycle callbacks.
Registry pointer identity becomes a monotonic registry generation because Workdeck isolates extensions in native subprocesses rather than sharing in-process JavaScript closures.
Retained capabilities hold weak owned generation leases; hard app teardown, registry replacement, and review reload revoke the appropriate scope without keeping an app alive.
Command execution is declarative in extension API v1. Runtime controls expose the latest enabled command table and produce host-validated ExecuteReviewCommand actions.
Navigation resolutions carry the latest binding revision and selected file facts; ReviewApp performs the resolved action against its current state after the lease check.
Rust-owned values replace Object.freeze while preserving invocation-time selection and snapshot immutability.
